question: Should Google Meet attendance CSV prioritize spreadsheet formula neutralization by prefixing dangerous cells with an apostrophe, accepting that raw CSV consumers receive the added character?
rationale: The implementation and proof establish the behavior, but automation cannot decide the intended compatibility contract for existing machine consumers of attendance CSV output.

options.title: Accept the targeted CSV contract
options.body: Merge the current implementation, treating the apostrophe as the intentional compatibility cost for spreadsheet-safe formula-like cells.

options.title: Require a different mitigation contract
options.body: Pause merge and select an Excel-resistant or application-specific encoding strategy with corresponding cross-application behavior proof.

recommendation.title: Accept the targeted CSV contract
recommendation.body: Merge the current implementation, treating the apostrophe as the intentional compatibility cost for spreadsheet-safe formula-like cells.
